corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This research provides directional evidence that Bitcoin is sensitive to monetary policy narratives, not just realized rate changes. The paper suggests that LLM-derived sentiment measures could potentially serve as indicators for understanding crypto market dynamics. The finding that ex-ante expectations may matter more than ex-post implementation challenges assumptions about Bitcoin as a pure inflation hedge, though specific quantitative thresholds and practical trading applications require full paper review.
